//: Shared defaults for every environment. Environment-specific files layer ON TOP of this one: appsettings.{Environment}.json, then appsettings.ServerUpdate.json (always last, see Program.cs). Never put a real secret here — this file ships in Git and in every publish.
//Front: ShowFrontPageAsDefault overrides the licence AND the admin's FrontShowSite setting, for staging a public site before its licence exists. Leave unset to let the licence and the switch decide. Do not set it in Production.

Guide.//: Screenshot slot names for the illustrated user guide, in section order. Purely documentation — the page derives file names as /img/guide/<NN>-<slug>.png, and lists the expected files here so an operator knows what to shoot. A slot with no file renders a labelled placeholder instead of a broken image.
